## Hi, I'm Emily

I was first introduced to Data Science when I took the Intro to Data Science with R class at Willamette University. Reading is the thread that runs through it. In high school the public library was where I could always get books, and that access is what still pulls me toward this kind of work: making sure the right resources stay within reach of the people who rely on them. What keeps me in data science is the moment a messy pile of exports turns into a chart that settles an argument.

At Willamette my focus has been data engineering and descriptive analysis, the unglamorous work of getting inconsistent sources into one honest table before anyone draws a conclusion from it. My [capstone](capstone.qmd) is where that comes together: seven publisher usage reports, five platforms, two versions of the same reporting standard, and a stakeholder who needs a defensible answer.
